content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation sets out the grounds (or ‘safe harbours’) that enable contracting authorities to modify PCR 2015-regulated contracts and framework agreements without conducting a new procurement procedure.
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Overview

content_blocks.text: The permitted modification grounds set out various conditions that must be satisfied in order to rely on the relevant ‘safe harbour’. Permitted modification grounds include certain circumstances where:
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Overview

content_blocks.text: a) modifications are set out in the initial procurement documents in clear, precise and unequivocal review clauses
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Overview

content_blocks.text: b) additional goods, works and services up to 50% of the original contract value have become necessary and a change of supplier cannot be made for economic or technical reasons
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Overview

content_blocks.text: c) changes have been brought about by circumstances which the contracting authority could not have foreseen, and any increase in price does not exceed 50% of the original contract value
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Overview

content_blocks.text: d) a new contractor replaces the one to which the contracting authority initially awarded the contract
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Overview

content_blocks.text: e) the modification, irrespective of value, is non-substantial
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Overview

content_blocks.text: f) the value of the modification is below certain ‘de minimis’ thresholds (applied cumulatively to successive changes.
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Overview

content_blocks.text: The conditions relating to modification grounds (b) and (c), above, also include a requirement for the contracting authority to publish a modification notice on Find a Tender to advertise the contract change.
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Overview

content_blocks.text: Objective at this commercial stage
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: The modification of a PCR-regulated contract or framework agreement triggers a requirement to conduct a new procurement process, other than in circumstances where one or more of the permitted modification grounds apply.
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Key considerations at this commercial stage
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Contracting authorities should:
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: ensure that contract modifications satisfy all relevant conditions of the permitted modification ground relied upon, including value thresholds where applicable
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: where required by the permitted modification ground, ensure that a modification notice is published on Find a Tender to advertise the contract change.
heading_path: Modification of contracts during their term
Key considerations at this commercial stage
